scope: Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Chapter 5 (with Online Appendix A1.7-A1.13): Fiscal theory in sticky-price models. The new Keynesian model with the Euler equation as an exact derivative and the two-sided moving-average characterisation; determinacy of the fiscal-theory NK model with the real value of debt as the predetermined state (rho < 1; at rho = 1 only the transversality condition selects); peg closed forms for permanent, anticipated and AR(1) rate rises and fiscal shocks; long-term debt and the impact-disinflation condition; surplus processes, the s-shape and active versus passive fiscal policy ((5.38) corrected: passive iff gamma = alpha); nonlinear continuous time; policy rules with a copy of the general Blanchard-Kahn theorem, an exact model-level determinacy iff including boundaries, Table 5.1 corrected; the Sims model; continuous-time simple model, surplus responses and rules with Figure 5.10, Figure 5.11 and Table 5.2 values certified; bounded solutions of linear ODE systems. Printed errors corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: John H. Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Princeton University Press, Chapter 5, pp. 117-186, and Online Appendix A1.7-A1.13, pp. 569-585.
